strings.answer.no_cause: No replay-verified cause is available for this case.
strings.answer.no_check: No physical check is available for this case.
strings.answer.unknown: That information is not in the evidence for this case. I can only answer questions about the evidence.
strings.check.check_count_sheet: Compare the count sheet for {item} at {location} with scan timestamps and the recorded quantity. Verify which movements occurred before the count.
strings.check.check_transfer_docs: Compare the source document for {txn} with both stock records. Verify where {item} was stored and the SKU that was handled.
strings.check.opening_balance: Obtain an earlier physical count for {item} at {location}.
strings.check.pull_pick_slip: Pull the pick slip for {txn} at {location}. Compare the recorded and actual quantities of {item}.
strings.check.pull_receiving_doc: Pull the receiving document for {txn} at {location}. Compare its quantity of {item} with the movement log.
strings.check.recount_location: Recount {item} at {location}. If the recount equals the ledger balance, review the first count. If it matches the recorded count, inspect the movement trail.
strings.check.recount_pallet: Recount each pallet of {item} at {location}. If the total equals the ledger balance, correct the recorded physical count.
strings.check.scan_audit: Audit scans for {item} at {location} around {txn}. Match each scan to a distinct physical movement and check the count cutoff.
strings.check.verify_original_count: Recount {item} at {location} and verify the original count sheet.
strings.check.verify_pack_size: Inspect a sealed pack of {item} at {location}. If the units per pack match the proposed conversion, review the scanner's unit setting.
strings.narrative.abstain: The available evidence is too weak or ambiguous to select a cause.
strings.narrative.cause.cutoff_timing: The leading hypothesis is cutoff timing for {item} at {location}: movements crossed the count boundary in the wrong period.
strings.narrative.cause.double_scan: The leading hypothesis is a double scan of {item} at {location}: one physical movement appears to have been recorded twice.
strings.narrative.cause.item_swap: The leading hypothesis is an item swap involving {item} at {location}: two SKUs were recorded against the wrong products.
strings.narrative.cause.miscount: The leading hypothesis is a miscount of {item} at {location}: the recorded physical count is wrong.
strings.narrative.cause.missed_scan: The leading hypothesis is a missed scan of {item} at {location}: a real movement is missing from the ledger.
strings.narrative.cause.opening_balance: The leading hypothesis is an opening balance issue for {item} at {location}: the earlier count may be missing or wrong.
strings.narrative.cause.qty_typo: The leading hypothesis is a quantity typo for {item} at {location}: a movement was recorded with the wrong quantity.
strings.narrative.cause.residual_shrink: The leading hypothesis is residual shrink for {item} at {location}: no single ledger edit explains the whole gap.
strings.narrative.cause.unit_mismatch: The leading hypothesis is a unit mismatch for {item} at {location}: pack size and scanner units disagree.
strings.narrative.cause.wrong_location: The leading hypothesis is a wrong location for {item} at {location}: the stock was moved to a different bin.
strings.narrative.opening: The first physical count recorded {counted} units. Add an earlier count to establish an opening balance.
strings.narrative.summary: The ledger expected {expected} units of {item} at {location}. The physical count found {counted} ({gap} units).
